name: FoamCoupling
description: An engine for coupling Yade with the finite volume fluid solver OpenFOAM in parallel. Requirements : Yade compiled with MPI libs, OpenFOAM-6 (openfoam is not required for compilation).Yade is executed under MPI environment with OpenFOAM simultaneously, and using MPI communication routines data...

attributes.name: fluidDomains
attributes.description: list of fluid domain bounding fictitious fluid bodies that has the fluid mesh bounds

attributes.name: foamDeltaT
attributes.description: timestep in openfoam solver from exchangeDeltaT

attributes.name: dataExchangeInterval
attributes.description: Number of iterations/substepping : for stability and to be in sync with fluid solver calculated in exchangeDeltaT

attributes.name: isGaussianInterp
attributes.description: switch for Gaussian interpolation of field varibles in openfoam. Uses sumHydroForce to obtain hydrodynamic force

attributes.name: comm
attributes.description: Communicator to be used for MPI (converts mpi4py comm <-> c++ comm)

attributes.name: dead
attributes.description: If true, this engine will not run at all; can be used for making an engine temporarily deactivated and only resurrect it at a later point.

attributes.name: ompThreads
attributes.description: Number of threads to be used in the engine. If ompThreads<0 (default), the number will be typically OMP_NUM_THREADS or the number N defined by 'yade -jN' (this behavior can depend on the engine though). This attribute will only affect engines whose code includes openMP parallel regions (e.g. InteractionLoop). This attribute is mostly useful for experiments or when combining ParallelEngine with engines that run parallel regions, resulting in nested OMP loops with different number of threads at each level.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: execTime
attributes.description: Cumulative time in nanoseconds this Engine took to run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: execCount
attributes.description: Cumulative count this engine was run (only used if O.timingEnabled == True).

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Engine itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled == True.

methods.name: setIdList
methods.description: list of body ids in hydroForce coupling. (links to :yref: `FoamCoupling::bodyList` vector, used to build particle data FoamCoupling::particleData. FoamCoupling::particleData contains the particle pos, vel, angvel, radius and this is sent to foam. )

methods.name: killMPI
methods.description: Destroy MPI, to be called at the end of the simulation, from killMPI<FoamCoupling::killMPI>

methods.name: insertBodyId
methods.description: insert a new body id for hydrodynamic force coupling

methods.name: eraseId
methods.description: remove a body from hydrodynamic force coupling

methods.name: getNumBodies
methods.description: get the number of bodies in the coupling

methods.name: getIdList
methods.description: get the ids of bodies in coupling

methods.name: getFluidDomainBbox
methods.description: get the fluid domain bounding boxes, called once during simulation initialization.

methods.name: SetOpenFoamSolver
methods.description: Starts the Yade coupled OpenFOAM solver with the requested number of processes

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
